info.title: Ed-Fi Operational Data Store API
info.description:
The Ed-Fi ODS / API enables applications to read and write education data stored in an Ed-Fi ODS through a secure REST interface. 
***
 > *Note: Consumers of ODS / API information should sanitize all data for display and storage. The ODS / API provides reasonable safeguards against cross-site scripting attacks and other malicious content, but the platform does not and cannot guarantee that the data it contains is free of all potentially harmful content.* 
***

get.summary: Retrieves specific resources using the resource's property values (using the "Get" pattern).
get.description: This GET operation provides access to resources using the "Get" search pattern.  The values of any properties of the resource that are specified will be used to return all matching results (if it exists).

parameters.name: codeValue
parameters.description: A code or abbreviation that is used to refer to the descriptor.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of the descriptor.

parameters.name: effectiveBeginDate
parameters.description: The beginning date of the period when the descriptor is in effect. If omitted, the default is immediate effectiveness.

parameters.name: effectiveEndDate
parameters.description: The end date of the period when the descriptor is in effect.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: A globally unique namespace that identifies this descriptor set. Author is strongly encouraged to use the Universal Resource Identifier (http, ftp, file, etc.) for the source of the descriptor definition. Best practice is for this source to be the descriptor file itself, so that it can be machine-readable and be fetched in real-time, if necessary.

parameters.name: shortDescription
parameters.description: A shortened description for the descriptor.

parameters.name: Use-Snapshot
parameters.description: Indicates if the configured Snapshot should be used.

200.description: The requested resource was successfully retrieved.

Next-Page-Token.description: A token that can be used to retrieve the next contiguous page of items. If not present, it indicates that there are no more items in the current cursor paging context (which is the current partition if the starting token was obtained using the partitions endpoint).

post.summary: Creates or updates resources based on the natural key values of the supplied resource.
post.description: The POST operation can be used to create or update resources. In database terms, this is often referred to as an "upsert" operation (insert + update). Clients should NOT include the resource "id" in the JSON body because it will result in an error. The web service will identify whether the resource already exists based on the natural key values provided, and update or create the resource appropriately. It is recommended to use POST for both create and update except while updating natural key of a resource in which case PUT operation must be used.

requestBody.description: The JSON representation of the "absenceEventCategoryDescriptor" resource to be created or updated.

405.description: Method Is Not Allowed. When the Use-Snapshot header is set to true, the method is not allowed.

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: Use-Snapshot

200.description: The requested resource was successfully retrieved.

put.summary: Updates a resource based on the resource identifier.

Additionally, this API resource is not configured for cascading natural key updates. Natural key values for this resource cannot be changed using PUT operation, so the recommendation is to use POST as that supports upsert behavior.

parameters.description: The type of credits or units of value awarded for the completion of a course.

parameters.description: A description of the content standards and goals covered in the course. Reference may be made to state or national content standards.

parameters.description: The descriptive name given to a course of study offered in a school or other institution or organization. parameters.name: transitionNotificationDate

post.summary: Creates or updates resources based on the natural key values of the supplied resource.
post.description: The POST operation can be used to create or update resources. In database terms, this is often referred to as an "upsert" operation (insert + update). Clients should NOT include the resource "id" in the JSON body because it will result in an error. The web service will identify whether the resource already exists based on the natural key values provided, and update or create the resource appropriately. It is recommended to use POST for both create and update except while updating natural key of a resource in which case PUT operation must be used.

continuationOfServicesReasonDescriptor.description: The "continuation of services" provision found in Section 1304(e) of the statute provides that (1) a child who ceases to be a migratory child during a school term shall be eligible for services until the end of such term; (2) a child who is no longer a migratory child may continue to receive services for one additional school year, but only if comparable services are not available through other programs; and (3) secondary school students who were eligible for services in secondary school may continue to be served through credit accrual programs until graduation. Only students who received services at any time during their 36 month eligibility period may continue to receive services (not necessarily the same service).

candidateIdentifier.description: A unique alphanumeric code assigned to a candidate.

addresses.description: An unordered collection of candidateAddresses. The set of elements that describes an address, including the street address, city, state, and ZIP code.

birthCity.description: The city the student was born in.

birthCountryDescriptor.description: The country in which an individual is born. It is strongly recommended that entries use only ISO 3166 2-letter country codes.

birthDate.description: The month, day, and year on which an individual was born.

birthInternationalProvince.description: For students born outside of the U.S., the Province or jurisdiction in which an individual is born.

birthStateAbbreviationDescriptor.description: The abbreviation for the name of the state (within the United States) or extra-state jurisdiction in which an individual was born.

dateEnteredUS.description: For students born outside of the U.S., the date the student entered the U.S.

disabilities.description: An unordered collection of candidateDisabilities. The disability condition(s) that best describes an individual's impairment.

displacementStatus.description: Indicates a state health or weather related event that displaces a group of students, and may require additional funding, educational, or social services.

economicDisadvantaged.description: An indication of inadequate financial condition of an individual's family, as determined by family income, number of family members/dependents, participation in public assistance programs, and/or other characteristics considered relevant by federal, state, and local policy.

electronicMails.description: An unordered collection of candidateElectronicMails. The numbers, letters, and symbols used to identify an electronic mail (e-mail) user within the network to which the individual or organization belongs.

englishLanguageExamDescriptor.description: Indicates that a person passed, failed, or did not take an English Language assessment (e.g., TOEFFL).

firstGenerationStudent.description: Indicator of whether individual is a first generation college student.

firstName.description: A name given to an individual at birth, baptism, or during another naming ceremony, or through legal change.

generationCodeSuffix.description: An appendage, if any, used to denote an individual's generation in his family (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

hispanicLatinoEthnicity.description: An indication that the individual traces his or her origin or descent to Mexico, Puerto Rico, Cuba, Central, and South America, and other Spanish cultures, regardless of race. The term, "Spanish origin," can be used in addition to "Hispanic or Latino."

languages.description: An unordered collection of candidateLanguages. The language(s) the individual uses to communicate.

lastSurname.description: The name borne in common by members of a family.

limitedEnglishProficiencyDescriptor.description: An indication that the student has been identified as limited English proficient by the Language Proficiency Assessment Committee (LPAC), or English proficient.

middleName.description: A secondary name given to an individual at birth, baptism, or during another naming ceremony.

multipleBirthStatus.description: Indicator of whether the student was born with other siblings (i.e., twins, triplets, etc.)

otherNames.description: An unordered collection of candidateOtherNames. Other names (e.g., alias, nickname, previous legal name) associated with a person.

personalIdentificationDocuments.description: An unordered collection of candidatePersonalIdentificationDocuments. The documents presented as evident to verify one's personal identity; for example: drivers license, passport, birth certificate, etc.

personalTitlePrefix.description: A prefix used to denote the title, degree, position, or seniority of the individual.

preferredFirstName.description: The first name the individual prefers, if different from their legal first name

preferredLastSurname.description: The last name the individual prefers, if different from their legal last name

races.description: An unordered collection of candidateRaces. The general racial category which most clearly reflects the individual's recognition of his or her community or with which the individual most identifies. The data model allows for multiple entries so that each individual can specify all appropriate races.

telephones.description: An unordered collection of candidateTelephones. The 10-digit telephone number, including the area code, for the person.

_etag.description: A unique system-generated value that identifies the version of the resource.

_lastModifiedDate.description: The date and time the resource was last modified.

addressTypeDescriptor.description: The type of address listed for an individual or organization.    For example:  Physical Address, Mailing Address, Home Address, etc.)

stateAbbreviationDescriptor.description: The abbreviation for the state (within the United States) or outlying area in which an address is located.

city.description: The name of the city in which an address is located.

postalCode.description: The five or nine digit zip code or overseas postal code portion of an address.

streetNumberName.description: The street number and street name or post office box number of an address.

localeDescriptor.description: A general geographic indicator that categorizes U.S. territory (e.g., City, Suburban).

apartmentRoomSuiteNumber.description: The apartment, room, or suite number of an address.

buildingSiteNumber.description: The number of the building on the site, if more than one building shares the same address.

congressionalDistrict.description: The congressional district in which an address is located.

countyFIPSCode.description: The Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) numeric code for the county issued by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). Counties are considered to be the "first-order subdivisions" of each State and statistically equivalent entity, regardless of their local designations (county, parish, borough, etc.) Counties in different States will have the same code. A unique county number is created when combined with the 2-digit FIPS State Code.

doNotPublishIndicator.description: An indication that the address should not be published.

latitude.description: The geographic latitude of the physical address.

longitude.description: The geographic longitude of the physical address.

nameOfCounty.description: The name of the county, parish, borough, or comparable unit (within a state) in which an address is located.

periods.description: An unordered collection of candidateAddressPeriods. The time periods for which the address is valid. For physical addresses, the periods in which the person lived at that address.

beginDate.description: The month, day, and year for the start of the period.  Note: Date interpretation may vary. Ed-Fi recommends inclusive dates, but states may define dates as inclusive or exclusive. For calculations, align with local guidelines.

endDate.description: The month, day, and year for the end of the period.  Note: Date interpretation may vary. Ed-Fi recommends inclusive dates, but states may define dates as inclusive or exclusive. For calculations, align with local guidelines.

disabilityDescriptor.description: A disability category that describes a individual's impairment.

disabilityDeterminationSourceTypeDescrip.description: The source that provided the disability determination.

disabilityDiagnosis.description: A description of the disability diagnosis.

orderOfDisability.description: The order by severity of individual's disabilities: 1- Primary, 2 -  Secondary, 3 - Tertiary, etc.

designations.description: An unordered collection of candidateDisabilityDesignations. Whether the disability is IDEA, Section 504, or other disability designation.

disabilityDesignationDescriptor.description: Whether the disability is IDEA, Section 504, or other disability designation.

beginDate.description: The begin date for the association.  Note: Date interpretation may vary. Ed-Fi recommends inclusive dates, but states may define dates as inclusive or exclusive. For calculations, align with local guidelines.

cohortYears.description: An unordered collection of candidateEducatorPreparationProgramAssociationCohortYears. The type and year of a cohort the student belongs to as determined by the year that student entered a specific grade.

degreeSpecializations.description: An unordered collection of candidateEducatorPreparationProgramAssociationDegreeSpecializations. Information around the area(s) of specialization for an individual.

endDate.description: The end date for the association.  Note: Date interpretation may vary. Ed-Fi recommends inclusive dates, but states may define dates as inclusive or exclusive. For calculations, align with local guidelines.

eppProgramPathwayDescriptor.description: The program pathway the candidate is following; for example: Residency, Internship, Traditional

minorSpecialization.description: The minor area for a degree or area of specialization for a certificate.

electronicMailTypeDescriptor.description: The type of email listed for an individual or organization. For example: Home/Personal, Work, etc.)

electronicMailAddress.description: The electronic mail (e-mail) address listed for an individual or organization.

doNotPublishIndicator.description: An indication that the electronic email address should not be published.

primaryEmailAddressIndicator.description: An indication that the electronic mail address should be used as the principal electronic mail address for an individual or organization.

uses.description: An unordered collection of candidateLanguageUses. A description of how the language is used (e.g. Home Language, Native Language, Spoken Language).

personalInformationVerificationDescripto.description: The category of the document relative to its purpose.

Created.description: The resource was created.  An ETag value is available in the ETag header, and the location of the resource is available in the Location header of the response.

Updated.description: The resource was updated.  An updated ETag value is available in the ETag header of the response.

NotModified.description: The resource's current server-side ETag value matched the If-None-Match header value supplied with the request indicating the resource has not been modified.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request. The request was invalid and cannot be completed. See the response body for specific validation errors. This will typically be an issue with the query parameters or their values.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized. The request requires authentication. The OAuth bearer token was either not provided or is invalid. The operation may succeed once authentication has been successfully completed.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden. The request cannot be completed in the current authorization context. Contact your administrator if you believe this operation should be allowed.

NotFound.description: The resource could not be found.

NotFoundUseSnapshot.description: The resource could not be found. If Use-Snapshot header is set to true, this response can indicate the snapshot may have been removed.

Conflict.description: Conflict.  The request cannot be completed because it would result in an invalid state.  See the response body for details.

PreconditionFailed.description: The resource's current server-side ETag value does not match the supplied If-Match header value in the request. This indicates the resource has been modified by another consumer.

Error.description: An unhandled error occurred on the server. See the response body for details.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Indicates how many items should be skipped before returning results.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Indicates the maximum number of items that should be returned in the results.

MinChangeVersion.name: minChangeVersion
MinChangeVersion.description: Used in synchronization to set sequence minimum ChangeVersion

MaxChangeVersion.name: maxChangeVersion
MaxChangeVersion.description: Used in synchronization to set sequence maximum ChangeVersion

If-None-Match.name: If-None-Match
If-None-Match.description: The previously returned ETag header value, used here to prevent the unnecessary data transfer of an unchanged resource.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Specifies a subset of properties that should be returned for each entity (e.g. "property1,collection1(collProp1,collProp2)").

queryExpression.name: q
queryExpression.description: Specifies a query filter expression for the request. Currently only supports range-based queries on dates and numbers (e.g. "schoolId:[255901000...255901002]" and "BeginDate:[2016-03-07...2016-03-10]").

totalCount.name: totalCount
totalCount.description: Indicates if the total number of items available should be returned in the 'Total-Count' header of the response.  If set to false, 'Total-Count' header will not be provided. Must be false when using cursor paging (with pageToken).

pageToken.name: pageToken
pageToken.description: The token of the page to retrieve, obtained either from the "Next-Page-Token" header of the previous request, or from the "partitions" endpoint for the resource. Cannot be used with limit/offset paging.

pageSize.name: pageSize
pageSize.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve in the page. For use with pageToken (cursor paging) only.

numberOfPartitions.name: number
numberOfPartitions.description: The number of evenly distributed partitions to provide for client-side parallel processing. If unspecified, a reasonable set of partitions will be determined based on the total number of accessible items.

tags.name: cteProgramServiceDescriptors

tags.name: diplomaTypeDescriptors

tags.name: disciplineIncidentParticipationCodeDescriptors
tags.description: The role or type of participation of a person in a discipline incident; for example: Victim, Perpetrator, Witness, Reporter.

tags.name: disciplineIncidents
tags.description: This event entity represents an occurrence of an infraction ranging from a minor behavioral problem that disrupts the orderly functioning of a school or classroom (such as tardiness) to a criminal act that results in the involvement of a law enforcement official (such as robbery). A single event (e.g., a fight) is one incident regardless of how many perpetrators or victims are involved. Discipline incidents are events classified as warranting discipline action.

tags.name: displacedStudentStatusDescriptors
tags.description: Indicates whether a student has been displaced as a result of a crisis event.

tags.name: dualCreditInstitutionDescriptors
tags.description: Custom descriptor of college institutions or categories of institutions participating in the dual credit program.

tags.name: dualCreditTypeDescriptors
tags.description: Indicates the type of the dual credit program.

tags.name: educationalEnvironmentDescriptors
tags.description: The setting in which a child receives education and related services.

tags.name: educationContents
tags.description: This entity represents materials for students or teachers that can be used for teaching, learning, research, and more. Education content includes full courses, course materials, modules, intervention descriptions, textbooks, streaming videos, tests, software, and any other tools, materials, or techniques used to support access to knowledge.

tags.name: educationOrganizationAssociationTypeDescriptors

tags.name: educationOrganizationNetworkAssociations

tags.name: evaluationPeriodDescriptors

tags.name: evaluationRatingLevelDescriptors

tags.name: evaluationRatings

The functions of a school district are generally classified into five broad areas, including instruction, support services, operation of non-instructional services, facilities acquisition and construction, and debt service.

tags.name: fundDimensions
tags.description: The NCES fund accounting dimension. A fund is a fiscal and accounting entity with a self-balancing set of accounts recording cash and other financial resources, together with all related liabilities and residual equities or balances, and changes therein, which are segregated for the purpose of carrying on specific activities or attaining certain objectives in accordance with special regulations, restrictions, or limitations.

tags.name: genderDescriptors

tags.name: gradebookEntryTypeDescriptors

tags.name: gradePointAverageTypeDescriptors

tags.name: gradeTypeDescriptors

tags.name: gradingPeriodDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the state's name of the period for which grades are reported.

tags.name: gradingPeriods
tags.description: This entity represents the time span for which grades are reported.

tags.name: graduationPlans

tags.name: graduationPlanTypeDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the set of graduation plan types.

tags.name: gunFreeSchoolsActReportingStatusDescriptors
tags.description: An indication of whether the school or local education agency (LEA) submitted a Gun-Free Schools Act (GFSA) of 1994 report to the state, as defined by Title 18, Section 921.

tags.name: homelessPrimaryNighttimeResidenceDescriptors
tags.description: The primary nighttime residence of the student at the time the student is identified as homeless.

tags.name: homelessProgramServiceDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the services provided by an education organization to populations of students associated with a homeless program.

tags.name: ideaPartDescriptors
tags.description: Indicates if the evaluation is done under Part B IDEA or Part C IDEA.

tags.name: identificationDocumentUseDescriptors
tags.description: Identifies the type of use given to an identification document.

tags.name: immunizationTypeDescriptors
tags.description: An indication of the type of immunization that an individual has satisfactorily received.

tags.name: incidentLocationDescriptors
tags.description: Identifies where the incident occurred and whether or not it occurred on school property.

tags.name: indicatorDescriptors
tags.description: The name or code for the indicator or metric.

tags.name: indicatorGroupDescriptors
tags.description: The name for a group of indicators.

tags.name: indicatorLevelDescriptors
tags.description: The value of the indicator or metric, as a value from a controlled vocabulary. The semantics of an empty value is "not submitted."

tags.name: institutionTelephoneNumberTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The type of communication number listed for an organization.

tags.name: interactivityStyleDescriptors
tags.description: The predominate mode of learning supported by the learning resource. Acceptable values are active, expositive, or mixed.

tags.name: internetAccessDescriptors
tags.description: The type of Internet access available.

tags.name: internetAccessTypeInResidenceDescriptors
tags.description: The primary type of internet service used in the student s primary place of residence.

tags.name: internetPerformanceInResidenceDescriptors
tags.description: An indication of whether the student can complete the full range of learning activities, including video streaming and assignment upload, without interruptions caused by poor internet performance in their primary place of residence.

tags.name: interventionClassDescriptors
tags.description: The way in which an intervention is used: curriculum, supplement, or practice.

tags.name: interventionEffectivenessRatingDescriptors
tags.description: An intervention demonstrates effectiveness if the research has shown that the program caused an improvement in outcomes. Rating Values: positive effects, potentially positive effects, mixed effects, potentially negative effects, negative effects, and no discernible effects.

tags.name: interventionPrescriptions
tags.description: This entity represents a formal prescription of an instructional approach focusing on the specific techniques and materials used to teach a given subject. This can be prescribed by academic research, an interventions vendor, or another entity.

tags.name: interventions
tags.description: An implementation of an instructional approach focusing on the specific techniques and materials used to teach a given subject.

tags.name: interventionStudies
tags.description: An experimental or quasi-experimental study of an intervention technique.

tags.name: languageDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the language(s) that are spoken or written. It is strongly recommended that entries use only ISO 639-2 language codes: for CodeValue, use the 3 character code; for ShortDescription and Description use the full language name.

tags.name: languageInstructionProgramServiceDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the services provided by an education organization to populations of students associated with a language instruction program.

tags.name: languageUseDescriptors
tags.description: The category denoting how a language is used.

tags.name: learningStandardCategoryDescriptors
tags.description: An additional classification of the type of a specific learning standard.

tags.name: learningStandardEquivalenceAssociations
tags.description: Indicates a directional association of equivalence from a source to a target learning standard.

tags.name: learningStandardEquivalenceStrengthDescriptors
tags.description: A measure that indicates the strength or quality of the equivalence relationship.

tags.name: learningStandards
tags.description: A statement that describes a specific competency or academic standard.

tags.name: learningStandardScopeDescriptors
tags.description: Signals the scope of usage the standard. Does not necessarily relate the standard to the governing body.

tags.name: levelOfEducationDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the different levels of education achievable.

tags.name: licenseStatusDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the license statuses.

tags.name: licenseTypeDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the type of a license.

tags.name: limitedEnglishProficiencyDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the indications that the student has been identified as limited English proficient by the Language Proficiency Assessment Committee (LPAC), or English proficient.

tags.name: localAccounts
tags.description: The set of account codes defined by an education organization for a fiscal year. It provides a formal record of the debits and credits relating to the specific account.

tags.name: localActuals
tags.description: The set of local education agency or charter management organization expense or revenue amounts.

tags.name: localBudgets
tags.description: The set of local education agency or charter management organization budget amounts.

tags.name: localContractedStaffs
tags.description: The set of local education agency or charter management organization contracted staff amounts.

tags.name: localeDescriptors
tags.description: A general geographic indicator that categorizes U.S. territory (e.g., City, Suburban).

tags.name: localEducationAgencies
tags.description: This entity represents an administrative unit at the local level which exists primarily to operate schools or to contract for educational services. It includes school districts, charter schools, charter management organizations, or other local administrative organizations.

tags.name: localEducationAgencyCategoryDescriptors
tags.description: The category of local education agency/district. For example: Independent or Charter.

tags.name: localEncumbrances
tags.description: The set of local education agency or charter management organization encumbrance amounts.

tags.name: localPayrolls
tags.description: The set of local education agency or charter management organization payroll amounts.

tags.name: locations
tags.description: This entity represents the physical space where students gather for a particular class/section. The location may be an indoor or outdoor area designated for the purpose of meeting the educational needs of students.

tags.name: magnetSpecialProgramEmphasisSchoolDescriptors
tags.description: A school that has been designed to attract students of different racial/ethnic backgrounds for the purpose of reducing, preventing or eliminating racial isolation; and/or to provide an academic or social focus on a particular theme (e.g., science/math, performing arts, gifted/talented, or foreign language).

tags.name: mediumOfInstructionDescriptors
tags.description: The media through which teachers provide instruction to students and students and teachers communicate about instructional matters.

tags.name: methodCreditEarnedDescriptors
tags.description: The method the credits were earned, for example:  Classroom, Examination, Transfer.

tags.name: migrantEducationProgramServiceDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the services provided by an education organization to populations of students associated with a migrant education program.

tags.name: modelEntityDescriptors
tags.description: The class of a domain entity in the Ed-Fi data model.

tags.name: monitoredDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines monitorization statuses for students who are no longer receiving language instruction program services.

tags.name: neglectedOrDelinquentProgramDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the type of program under ESEA Title I, Part D, Subpart 1 (state programs) or Subpart 2 (LEA).

tags.name: neglectedOrDelinquentProgramServiceDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the services provided by an education organization to populations of students associated with a neglected or delinquent program.

tags.name: networkPurposeDescriptors
tags.description: The purpose(s) of the network, e.g. shared services, collective procurement, etc.

tags.name: nonMedicalImmunizationExemptionDescriptors
tags.description: The type of nonmedical exemption from vaccination claimed by the student's parent or guardian.

tags.name: objectDimensions
tags.description: The NCES object accounting dimension representing an expenditure. Per the NCES definition, this classification is used to describe the service or commodity obtained as the result of a specific expenditure, such as salaries, benefits, tuition reimbursement, and so forth.

tags.name: objectiveAssessments
tags.description: This entity represents subtests that assess specific learning objectives.

tags.name: objectiveRatingLevelDescriptors
tags.description: Rating levels for Evaluation Objectives.

tags.name: openStaffPositions
tags.description: This entity represents an open staff position that the education organization is seeking to fill.

tags.name: operationalStatusDescriptors
tags.description: The current operational status of the education organization (e.g., active, inactive).

tags.name: operationalUnitDimensions
tags.description: The NCES operational unit accounting dimension. This dimension is used to segregate costs by school and operational unit such as physical location, department, or other method.

tags.name: organizationDepartments
tags.description: An organizational unit of another education organization, often devoted to a particular academic discipline, area of study, or organization function.

tags.name: otherNameTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The types of alternate names for a person.

tags.name: participationDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines participation in a yearly English language assessment.

tags.name: participationStatusDescriptors
tags.description: The student's program participation status.

tags.name: people
tags.description: This entity represents a human being.

tags.name: performanceBaseConversionDescriptors
tags.description: Defines standard levels of competency or performance that can be used for dashboard visualizations: advanced, proficient, basic, and below basic.

tags.name: performanceEvaluationRatingLevelDescriptors
tags.description: Rating levels for Performance Evaluations.

tags.name: performanceEvaluationRatings
tags.description: The summary rating for a Performance Evaluation across all Evaluation instruments for an individual educator.

tags.name: performanceEvaluations
tags.description: A performance evaluation of an educator, typically regularly scheduled and uniformly applied, composed of one or more Evaluations.

tags.name: performanceEvaluationTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The type of performance evaluation conducted (e.g., walkthrough, summative).

tags.name: performanceLevelDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines various levels or thresholds for performance on the assessment.

tags.name: personalInformationVerificationDescriptors
tags.description: The evidence presented to verify one's personal identity; for example: driver's license, passport, birth certificate, etc.

tags.name: platformTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The platforms with which an assessment may be delivered.

tags.name: populationServedDescriptors
tags.description: The type of students the Section is offered and tailored to.

tags.name: postingResultDescriptors
tags.description: Indication of whether the position was filled or retired without filling.

tags.name: postSecondaryEventCategoryDescriptors
tags.description: A code describing the type of post-secondary event (e.g., college application or acceptance).

tags.name: postSecondaryEvents
tags.description: This entity captures significant postsecondary events during a student's high school tenure (e.g., FAFSA application or college application, acceptance, and enrollment) or during a student's enrollment at a post-secondary institution.

tags.name: postSecondaryInstitutionLevelDescriptors
tags.description: A classification of a postsecondary institution's highest level of offering. Default values are based on the Carnegie Classifications.

tags.name: postSecondaryInstitutions
tags.description: An organization that provides educational programs for individuals who have completed or otherwise left educational programs in secondary school(s).

tags.name: primaryLearningDeviceAccessDescriptors
tags.description: An indication of whether the primary learning device is shared or not shared with another individual.

tags.name: primaryLearningDeviceAwayFromSchoolDescriptors
tags.description: The type of device the student uses most often to complete learning activities away from school.

tags.name: primaryLearningDeviceProviderDescriptors
tags.description: The provider of the primary learning device.

tags.name: proficiencyDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines proficiency levels for a yearly English language assessment.

tags.name: programAssignmentDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the name of the education program for which a teacher is assigned to a school.

tags.name: programCharacteristicDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines important characteristics of the Program, such as categories or particular indications.

tags.name: programDimensions
tags.description: The NCES program accounting dimension. A program is defined by the NCES as a plan of activities and procedures designed to accomplish a predetermined objective or set of objectives. These are often categorized into broad program areas such as regular education, special education, vocational education, other PK-12 instructional, nonpublic school, adult and continuing education, community and junior college education, community services, and co-curricular or extracurricular activities.

tags.name: programEvaluationElements
tags.description: The lowest level elements or criterion of a students's performance that is being evaluated, typically by a rubric.

tags.name: programEvaluationObjectives
tags.description: A subcomponent of a ProgramEvaluation, a specific student objective or domain of performance that is being evaluated.

tags.name: programEvaluationPeriodDescriptors
tags.description: The period for the evaluation.

tags.name: programEvaluations
tags.description: An evaluation instrument applied to evaluate a student in the context of a program. Student evaluations are typically applied by a staff member based upon a rubric.

tags.name: programEvaluationTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The type of the evaluation.

tags.name: programs
tags.description: This entity represents any program designed to work in conjunction with, or as a supplement to, the main academic program. Programs may provide instruction, training, services, or benefits through federal, state, or local agencies. Programs may also include organized extracurricular activities for students.

tags.name: programSponsorDescriptors
tags.description: Ultimate and intermediate providers of funds for a particular educational or service program or activity or for an individual's participation in the program or activity (e.g., Federal, State, ESC, District, School, Private Org).

tags.name: programTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The formal name of the program of instruction, training, services, or benefits available through federal, state, or local agencies.

tags.name: progressDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines yearly progress or growth from last year's assessment.

tags.name: progressLevelDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines progress measured from pre- to post-test.

tags.name: projectDimensions
tags.description: The NCES project accounting dimension. The project dimension reporting code permits school districts to accumulate expenditures to meet a variety of specialized reporting requirements at the local, state, and federal levels.

tags.name: providerCategoryDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor holds the category of the provider.

tags.name: providerProfitabilityDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor indicates the profitability status of the provider.

tags.name: providerStatusDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the status of the provider.

tags.name: publicationStatusDescriptors
tags.description: The publication status of the document (i.e., Adopted, Draft, Published, Deprecated, Unknown).

tags.name: questionFormDescriptors
tags.description: The form or type of question.

tags.name: raceDescriptors
tags.description: The enumeration items defining the racial categories which most clearly reflects the individual's recognition of his or her community or with which the individual most identifies.

tags.name: ratingLevelDescriptors
tags.description: The descriptive level(s) of ratings (cut scores) for evaluation.

tags.name: reasonExitedDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the reason a student exited a program.

tags.name: reasonNotTestedDescriptors
tags.description: The primary reason student is not tested.

tags.name: recognitionTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The nature of recognition given to the student for accomplishments in a co-curricular, or extra-curricular activity.

tags.name: relationDescriptors
tags.description: The nature of an individual's relationship to a student.

tags.name: repeatIdentifierDescriptors
tags.description: An indication as to whether a student has previously taken a given course.

tags.name: reportCards
tags.description: This educational entity represents the collection of student grades for courses taken during a grading period.

tags.name: reporterDescriptionDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the type of individual who reported an incident.

tags.name: reportingTagDescriptors
tags.description: A descriptor used at the dimension and/or chart of account levels to demote specific state needs for reporting.

tags.name: residencyStatusDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines indications of the location of a person's legal residence relative to (within or outside of) the boundaries of the public school attended and its administrative unit.

tags.name: responseIndicatorDescriptors
tags.description: Indicator of the response.

tags.name: responsibilityDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines types of responsibility an education organization may have for a student (e.g., accountability, attendance, funding).

tags.name: restraintEventReasonDescriptors
tags.description: The items of categorization of the circumstances or reason for the restraint.

tags.name: restraintEvents
tags.description: This event entity represents the instances where a special education student was physically or mechanically restrained due to imminent serious physical harm to themselves or others, imminent serious property destruction or a combination of both imminent serious physical harm to themselves or others and imminent serious property destruction.

tags.name: resultDatatypeTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The results can be expressed as a number, percentile, range, level, etc.

tags.name: retestIndicatorDescriptors
tags.description: Indicator if the test was retaken.

tags.name: rubricDimensions
tags.description: The cells of a rubric, consisting of a qualitative decription, definition, or exemplar with the associated rubric rating and rating level.

tags.name: rubricRatingLevelDescriptors
tags.description: Rating levels for Rubric Dimensions.

tags.name: schoolCategoryDescriptors
tags.description: The category of school. For example: High School, Middle School, Elementary School.

tags.name: schoolChoiceBasisDescriptors
tags.description: The legal basis for the school choice enrollment according to local, state or federal policy or regulation. (The descriptor provides the list of available bases specific to the state).

tags.name: schoolChoiceImplementStatusDescriptors
tags.description: An indication of whether the LEA was able to implement the provisions for public school choice under Title I, Part A, Section 1116 of ESEA, as amended.

tags.name: schoolFoodServiceProgramServiceDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the services provided by an education organization to populations of students associated with a school food service program.

tags.name: schools
tags.description: This entity represents an educational organization that includes staff and students who participate in classes and educational activity groups.

tags.name: schoolTypeDescriptors
tags.description: The type of education institution as classified by its primary focus such as Alternative, Career and Technical Education, Regular, or Special Education schools.

tags.name: schoolYearTypes
tags.description: Identifier for a school year.

tags.name: section504DisabilityDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the reason(s) why student qualifies for Section 504 consideration.

tags.name: sectionAttendanceTakenEvents
tags.description: Captures attendance taken event for given section.

tags.name: sectionCharacteristicDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines characteristics of a Section, such as whether attendance is taken and the Section is graded.

tags.name: sections
tags.description: This entity represents a setting in which organized instruction of course content is provided, in-person or otherwise, to one or more students for a given period of time. A course offering may be offered to more than one section.

tags.name: sectionTypeDescriptors
tags.description: Specifies whether the section is for attendance only, credit only, or both.

tags.name: separationDescriptors
tags.description: Type of employment separation; for example:  Voluntary separation, Involuntary separation, Mutual agreement. Other, etc.

tags.name: separationReasonDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the reasons for terminating the employment.

tags.name: serviceDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the services provided by an education organization to populations of students associated with a program.

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: A specific designated unit of time during which instruction is provided, grades are reported and academic credits are awarded to students (whenever applicable). Sessions serve as organized segments of the academic year and can be interrupted by vacations or other events.

tags.name: sexDescriptors
tags.description: A person's birth sex.

tags.name: sourceDimensions
tags.description: The NCES source dimension. This dimension is used to segregate costs by school and operational unit such as physical location, department, or other method.

tags.name: sourceSystemDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the originating record source system.

tags.name: specialEducationExitReasonDescriptors
tags.description: The reason why a person stops receiving special education services.

tags.name: specialEducationProgramServiceDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the services provided by an education organization to populations of students associated with a special education program.

tags.name: specialEducationSettingDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the major instructional setting (more than 50 percent of a student's special education program).

tags.name: staffAbsenceEvents
tags.description: This event entity represents the recording of the dates of staff absence.

tags.name: staffClassificationDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines an individual's title of employment, official status or rank.

tags.name: staffCohortAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the staff associated with a cohort of students.

tags.name: staffDisciplineIncidentAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates those staff who were victims, perpetrators, witnesses, and reporters for a discipline incident.

tags.name: staffEducationOrganizationAssignmentAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the education organization to which a staff member provides services.

tags.name: staffEducationOrganizationContactAssociations
tags.description: This association provides the contact information of the staff associated with the education organization.

tags.name: staffEducationOrganizationEmploymentAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the education organization an employee, contractor, volunteer, or other service provider is formally associated with typically indicated by which organization the staff member has a services contract with or receives compensation from.

tags.name: staffIdentificationSystemDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the originating record system and code that is used for record-keeping purposes of the staff.

tags.name: staffLeaveEventCategoryDescriptors
tags.description: A code describing the type of the leave event.

tags.name: staffLeaves
tags.description: This entity represents the recording of the dates of staff leave (e.g., sick leave, personal time, vacation).

tags.name: staffProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the staff associated with a program.

tags.name: staffs
tags.description: This entity represents an individual who performs specified activities for any public or private education institution or agency that provides instructional and/or support services to students or staff at the early childhood level through high school completion.

tags.name: staffSchoolAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the school(s) to which a staff member provides instructional services.

tags.name: staffSectionAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the class sections to which a staff member is assigned.

tags.name: stateAbbreviationDescriptors
tags.description: The abbreviation for the state (within the United States) or outlying area in which an address is located.

tags.name: stateEducationAgencies
tags.description: This entity represents the agency of the state charged with the primary responsibility for coordinating and supervising public instruction, including the setting of standards for elementary and secondary instructional programs.

tags.name: studentAcademicRecords
tags.description: This educational entity represents the cumulative record of academic achievement for a student.

tags.name: studentAssessmentEducationOrganizationAssociations
tags.description: The association of individual StudentAssessments with EducationOrganizations indicating administration, enrollment, or attribution.

tags.name: studentAssessmentRegistrationBatteryPartAssociations
tags.description: The association to the part(s) of the assessment battery that the student is to be tested for this administration of the assessment.

tags.name: studentAssessmentRegistrations
tags.description: Identifies an assessment registration that a student is expected to participate in including the testing organization, reporting organization and assessment delivery details.

tags.name: studentAssessments
tags.description: This entity represents the analysis or scoring of a student's response on an assessment. The analysis results in a value that represents a student's performance on a set of items on a test.

tags.name: studentCharacteristicDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor captures important characteristics of the student's environment or situation. Generally used for non-program-based student characteristics.

tags.name: studentCohortAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the cohort(s) for which a student is designated.

tags.name: studentCompetencyObjectives
tags.description: This entity represents the competency assessed or evaluated for the student against a specific competency objective.

tags.name: studentContactAssociations
tags.description: This association relates students to their parents, guardians, or caretakers.

tags.name: studentCTEProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the career and technical education (CTE) program that a student participates in. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for CTE programs.

tags.name: studentDisciplineIncidentBehaviorAssociations
tags.description: This association describes the behavior of students involved in a discipline incident.

tags.name: studentDisciplineIncidentNonOffenderAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates those students who were involved and not perpetrators for a discipline incident.

tags.name: studentEducationOrganizationAssessmentAccommodations
tags.description: The accommodation(s) required or expected for administering assessments as determined by the education organization.

tags.name: studentEducationOrganizationAssociations
tags.description: This association represents student information as reported in the context of the student's relationship to the education organization. Enrollment relationship semantics are covered by StudentSchoolAssociation.

tags.name: studentEducationOrganizationResponsibilityAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates a relationship between a student and an education organization other than an enrollment relationship, and generally indicating some kind of responsibility of the education organization for the student. Enrollment relationship semantics are covered by StudentSchoolAssociation.

tags.name: studentGradebookEntries
tags.description: This entity holds a student's grade or competency level for a gradebook entry.

tags.name: studentHealths
tags.description: This entity stores the student health records.

tags.name: studentHomelessProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the McKinney-Vento Homeless Program program(s) that a student participates in or from which the student receives services. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for homeless programs.

tags.name: studentIdentificationSystemDescriptors
tags.description: This descriptor defines the originating record system and code that is used for record-keeping purposes of the student.

tags.name: studentInterventionAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the students participating in an intervention.

tags.name: studentInterventionAttendanceEvents
tags.description: This event entity represents the recording of whether a student is in attendance for an intervention service.

tags.name: studentLanguageInstructionProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the Title III Language Instruction for Limited English Proficient and Immigrant Students program(s) that a student participates in or from which the student receives services. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for language instruction programs.

tags.name: studentMigrantEducationProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the migrant education program(s) that a student participates in or receives services from. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for migrant education programs.

tags.name: studentNeglectedOrDelinquentProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the Title I Part D Neglected or Delinquent program(s) that a student participates in or from which the student receives services. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for Title I Part D Neglected or Delinquent programs.

tags.name: studentProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the program(s) that a student participates in or is served by.

tags.name: studentProgramAttendanceEvents
tags.description: This event entity represents the recording of whether a student is in attendance to receive or participate in program services.

tags.name: studentProgramEvaluations
tags.description: The evaluation results for a student as evaluated in the context of a program.

tags.name: students
tags.description: This entity represents an individual for whom instruction, services, and/or care are provided in an early childhood, elementary, or secondary educational program under the jurisdiction of a school, education agency or other institution or program. A student is a person who has been enrolled in a school or other educational institution.

tags.name: studentSchoolAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the school in which a student is enrolled. The semantics of enrollment may differ slightly by state. Non-enrollment relationships between a student and an education organization may be described using the StudentEducationOrganizationAssociation.

tags.name: studentSchoolAttendanceEvents
tags.description: This event entity represents the recording of whether a student is in attendance for a school day.

tags.name: studentSchoolFoodServiceProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the school food services program(s), such as the Free or Reduced Lunch program, that a student participates in or from which the student receives services. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for school food service programs.

tags.name: studentSection504ProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association identifies student that qualifies for the Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973.

tags.name: studentSectionAssociations
tags.description: This association indicates the course sections to which a student is assigned.

tags.name: studentSectionAttendanceEvents
tags.description: This event entity represents the recording of whether a student is in attendance for a section.

tags.name: studentSpecialEducationProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the special education program(s) that a student participates in or receives services from. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for special education programs.

tags.name: studentSpecialEducationProgramEligibilityAssociations
tags.description: Captures details regarding the evaluation process for eligibility of students for special education services under IDEA Part C or Part B.

tags.name: studentTitleIPartAProgramAssociations
tags.description: This association represents the Title I Part A program(s) that a student participates in or from which the student receives services. The association is a subclass of the GeneralStudentProgramAssociation specifically designed for Title I Part A programs.

tags.name: studentTransportations
tags.description: This entity captures a student's specific transportation arrangement.

tags.name: submissionStatusDescriptors
tags.description: The status of the student's submission.

tags.name: supporterMilitaryConnectionDescriptors
tags.description: Military connection of the person/people whom the student is a dependent of.

tags.name: surveyCategoryDescriptors
tags.description: The descriptor holds the category or type of survey.

tags.name: surveyCourseAssociations
tags.description: The course associated with the survey.

tags.name: surveyLevelDescriptors
tags.description: Provides information about the respondents of a survey and how they can be grouped together.

tags.name: surveyProgramAssociations
tags.description: The program associated with the survey.

tags.name: surveyQuestionResponses
tags.description: The response to a survey question.

tags.name: surveyQuestions
tags.description: The questions for the survey.

tags.name: surveyResponseEducationOrganizationTargetAssociations
tags.description: This association provides information about the survey being taken and the education organization the survey is about.

tags.name: surveyResponsePersonTargetAssociations
tags.description: The association provides information about the survey being taken and who the survey is about.

tags.name: surveyResponses
tags.description: Responses to a Survey for named or anonymous persons.

tags.name: surveyResponseStaffTargetAssociations
tags.description: The association provides information about the survey being taken and who the survey is about.

tags.name: surveys
tags.description: A survey to identified or anonymous respondents.

tags.name: surveySectionAssociations
tags.description: The section associated with the survey.

tags.name: surveySectionResponseEducationOrganizationTargetAssociations
tags.description: This association provides information about the survey section and the education organization the survey section is about.

tags.name: surveySectionResponsePersonTargetAssociations
tags.description: This association provides information about the survey section and the person the survey section is about.

tags.name: surveySectionResponses
tags.description: Optional information about the responses provided for a section of a survey.
